walkthroughs.body_html:
Data Presentation & Interpretation — a core area of A-Level Maths.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Data Presentation & Interpretation brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Data Presentation & Interpretation.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the formula for the area of a circle?
options: pi * r^2 (pi times the radius squared).
9xy, by adding all the numbers and merging the letters.
The area of a circle is 2 * pi * r — the same as the circumference formula.
The area of a circle is pi * d, where d is the diameter.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Range, IQR, SD”?
options: Mean = sum/n. Median = middle value of ordered data. Mode = most frequent value. Different averages, different uses.
Show min, Q₁, median, Q₃, max. Visualise spread, skew, outliers. Useful for comparing distributions.
Range = max − min. IQR = Q₃ − Q₁ (middle 50% spread). Standard deviation σ = √(variance), more sensitive measure.
Running total. Plotting against upper class boundary gives an S-curve, used to estimate medians and quartiles.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Outliers”?
options: Running total. Plotting against upper class boundary gives an S-curve, used to estimate medians and quartiles.
Values far from the rest. Common rule: outside Q₁ − 1.5·IQR or Q₃ + 1.5·IQR. May skew mean.
Range = max − min. IQR = Q₃ − Q₁ (middle 50% spread). Standard deviation σ = √(variance), more sensitive measure.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Sampling”?
options: Values far from the rest. Common rule: outside Q₁ − 1.5·IQR or Q₃ + 1.5·IQR. May skew mean.
